_comment: Seeded web pages for the Fixture world's web search. A page is a result for a query that contains any of its keywords (case-insensitive). Domains end in .example: these are not real sites.

pages.title: RouteWise: route planning for small fleets
pages.content: RouteWise plans daily delivery routes for fleets of 5 to 50 vehicles. It imports orders from a CSV or ERP order export and connects to common fleet-tracking systems. It is a hosted (SaaS) service, priced per vehicle per month, with a 30-day trial.

pages.title: FleetPlanner Pro: vehicle routing for carriers
pages.content: FleetPlanner Pro is an on-premise vehicle routing system for mid-sized carriers, with delivery time windows, driver shifts and a planning API. It is licensed per year and usually needs an implementation partner.

pages.title: Route planning in SME logistics: build or buy?
pages.content: Most small carriers start with a hosted route planner; a custom planner pays off only when the planning rules are unusual. In either case the main integration work is getting clean order data and fleet data into the planner.

pages.title: Payment terms for business customers
pages.content: In the Netherlands, when no payment term has been agreed, a business customer must pay an invoice within 30 days. Businesses may agree a term of up to 60 days; a large company paying a small business may agree at most 30 days.

pages.title: When a business customer pays late
pages.content: Once the payment term has passed, a business customer is in default without a reminder, and you may charge the statutory commercial interest (wettelijke handelsrente) and collection costs. Sending a friendly payment reminder first is customary.
